title: Construction and installation.
officialText:
Pressure-relieving and pressure-limiting devices shall be constructed of materials so that the
operation of the devices will not be impaired by corrosion of external parts by the atmosphere or of internal parts by the gas.
Pressure-relieving and pressure-limiting devices shall be designed and installed so that they can be operated to determine whether
the valve is free. The devices shall also be designed and installed so that they can be tested to determine the pressure at which they
will operate and examined for leakage when in the closed position.
